title: Dua Kumail
introduction:
DUA KUMAYL

The Supplication of Kumayl ibn Ziyad al-Nakha’i, one of the close disciples of Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen(a.s.).

This is one of the well-known supplications. Being the supplication of al-Khizr (a.s.)‘Allamah al-Majlisi says that it is the best of all supplications, which Imam Ali Ameer al-Momineen(a.s.) taught to Kumayl, one of his best disciples. Recommendably, the supplication may be said during nights of mid-Sha’ban and every Thursday evening (i.e. the nights before Fridays). It is useful for protecting against the evil of enemies, for opening the gate of sustenance, and for forgiveness of sins. Both Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus have recorded this supplication; rather, I am quoting it from the book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid as follows:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، الَّتِیْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَیْئٍ،
verses.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which embraces all things,

verses.arabic: وَ بِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِیْ قَھَرْتَ بِھَا كُلَّ شَیْئٍ،
verses.translation: by Your strength, through which You dominate all things
toward which all things are humble,
and before which all things are lowly,

verses.arabic: وَ بِجَبَرُوْتِكَ الَّتِیْ غَلَبْتَ بِھَا كُلَّ شَیْئٍ،
verses.translation: by Your invincibility through which You overwhelm all things,

verses.arabic: وَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِیْ لَا یَقُوْمُ لَھَا شَیْئٌ،
verses.translation: by Your might, which nothing can resist,

verses.arabic: وَّ بِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتِیْ مَلَاَتْ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ،
verses.translation: by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things,

verses.arabic: وَّ بِسُلْطَانِكَ الَّذِیْ عَلٰی كُلَّ شَیْءٍ،
verses.translation: by Your authority, which towers over all thing,

verses.arabic: وَّ بِوَجْھِكَ الْبَاقِیْ بَعْدَ فَنَاۤءِ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ،
verses.translation: by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things,

verses.arabic: وَّ بِاَسْمَاۤئِكَ الَّتِیْ مَلَاَتْ اَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ،
verses.translation: by Your Names, which have filled the areas of all things,

verses.arabic: وَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الَّذِیْ اَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ،
verses.translation: by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things,

verses.arabic: وَّ بِنُوْرِ وَجْھِكَ الَّذِیْ اَضَاۤءَلَہٗ كُلُّ شَیْءٍ،
verses.translation: and by the light of Your Face, through which all things are illumined!
O Light! O All-holy!
O First of those who are first
and Last of those who are last!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَھْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ.
verses.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْلِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ.
verses.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُغَیِّرُ النِّعَمَ.
verses.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاۤءَ.
verses.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins, which hold back supplication!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تَقْطَعُ الرَّجَاۤءَ.
verses.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins, which cut down hopes!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیَ الذُّنُوْبَ الَّتِیْ تُنْزِلُ الْبَلَاۤءَ.
verses.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down tribulation!

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیْ كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ اَذْنَبْتُہٗ،
verses.translation: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed
and every mistake I have made!
O Allah, verily I seek nearness to You through remembrance of You,
I seek intercession from You with Yourself,

verses.arabic: وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِجُوْدِكَ، اَنْ تُدْنِیَنِیْ مِنْ قُرْبِكَ،
verses.translation: and I ask You in the name of Your munificence to bring me near to Your proximity,
to provide me with gratitude toward You,
and to inspire me with Your remembrance.
O Allah, verily I ask You with the asking of a submissive,
abased, and lowly man
to show me forbearance, to have mercy on me,
and to make me satisfied and content with Your appointment
and humble in every state.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ وَ اَسْئَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُہٗ،
verses.translation: O Allah, I ask You the beseeching of one whose indigence is extreme,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْزَلَ بِكَ عِنْدَ الشَّدَاۤئِدِ حَاجَتَہٗ،
verses.translation: who has stated to You in difficulties his need,
and whose desire for what is with You has become great.
O Allah, Your authority is tremendous,
Your place is lofty,
Your plan is hidden,
Your command is manifest,
Your domination is overwhelming,
Your power is unhindered

verses.arabic: وَ لَا یُمْكِنُ الْفِرَارُ مِنْ حُكُوْمَتِكَ.
verses.translation: and escape from Your governance is impossible.
O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins,
nor concealer of my ugly acts,

verses.arabic: وَّ لَا لِشَیْئٍ مِّنْ عَمَلِیَ الْقَبِیْحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلًا غَیْرَكَ،
verses.translation: nor transformer of any of my ugly acts into good acts but You.
There is no god but You!
Glory be to You, and Yours is the praise!
I have wronged myself,
been audacious in my ignorance,

verses.arabic: وَ سَكَنْتُ اِلٰی قَدِیْمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِیْ وَمَنِّكَ عَلَیَّ.
verses.translation: and depended upon Your eternal good turn to me and Your favor toward me.
O Allah! O my Protector!
Too many are the ugly things You have concealed!

verses.arabic: وَ كَمْ مِنْ فَادِحٍ مِنَ الْبَلَاۤءِ اَقَلْتَہٗ،
verses.translation: Too many are the burdensome tribulations You have abolished!
Too many are the stumbles You have prevented!
Too many are the ordeals You have repelled!

verses.arabic: وَ كَمْ مِنْ ثَنَاۤءٍ جَمِیْلٍ لَسْتُ اَھْلًا لَہٗ نَشَرْتَہٗ.
verses.translation: Too much is the beautiful praise, of which I was unworthy, You have spread abroad!
O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous,
my bad state is excessive,
my acts are inadequate,
my fetters have tied me down,

verses.arabic: وَ حَبَسَنِیْ عَنْ نَفْعِیْ بُعْدُ اَمَلِیْ،
verses.translation: my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my gain,
this world has seduced me with its delusions,
and my own soul and delay with its offences.
O my Master! So, I ask You by Your might
not to let my evil works and acts
veil my supplication from You,

verses.arabic: وَ لَا تَفْضَحْنِیْ بِخَفِیِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَیْہِ مِنْ سِرِّیْ,
verses.translation: not to disgrace me through the hidden things You know of my secrets,

verses.arabic: وَ لَا تُعَاجِلْنِیْ بِالْعُقُوْبَۃِ عَلٰی مَا عَمِلْتُہٗ فِیْ خَلَوَاتِیْ،
verses.translation: not to hasten punishment to me for what I have done in private,
such as my evil acts in secrecy and my misdeeds,
my continuous negligence, my ignorance,
my manifold passions, and my forgetfulness.
By Your might, O Allah,
be kind to me in all states,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَیَّ فِیْ جَمِیْعِ الْاُمُوْرِ عَطُوْفًا.
verses.translation: and be gracious to me in all affairs!

verses.arabic: اِلٰھِیْ وَ رَبِّیْ مَنْ لِیْ غَیْرُكَ،
verses.translation: My God and Lord! Whom do I have save You
from whom to ask removal of my affliction
and regard for my affairs!
My God and Protector!
You put into effect through me a decree
in which I followed the caprice of my own soul

verses.arabic: وَ لَمْ اَحْتَرِسْ فِیْہِ مِنْ تَزْیِیْنِ عَدُوِّیْ،
verses.translation: and I did not remain wary of adorning my enemy.
So, he deluded me through my soul's caprice
and therein destiny favored him.

verses.arabic: فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرٰی عَلَیَّ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُوْدِكَ،
verses.translation: So, in what was put into effect through me in that situation, I transgressed some of Your statutes
and disobeyed some of Your commands.

verses.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَیَّ فِیْ جَمِیْعِ ذٰلِكَ،
verses.translation: So, Yours is the argument against me in all of that

verses.arabic: وَ لَا حُجَّۃَ لِیْ فِیْمَا جَرٰی عَلَیَّ فِیْہِ قَضَاۤؤُكَ،
verses.translation: and I have no argument in what Your destiny put into effect through me therein
nor in what Your decree and Your test imposed upon me.
Now, I have come to You, My God,

verses.arabic: بَعْدَ تَقْصِیْرِیْ وَ اِسْرَافِیْ عَلٰی نَفْسِیْ،
verses.translation: after my shortcoming and immoderation toward myself,
proffering my excuse, regretful,
broken, apologizing,
asking forgiveness, repenting,
acknowledging, submissive, and confessing.

verses.arabic: لَا اَجِدُ مَفَرًّا مِمَّا كَانَ مِنِّیْ،
verses.translation: I find no place to flee from what I have shown

verses.arabic: وَ لَا مَفْزَعًا اَتَوَجَّہُ اِلَیْہِ فِیْ اَمْرِیْ
verses.translation: nor any place of escape to which I may turn in my affairs
other than Your acceptance of my excuse

verses.arabic: وَ اِدْخَالِكَ اِیَّایَ فِیْ سَعَۃِ رَحْمَتِكَ.
verses.translation: and Your entering me into the compass of Your mercy.
O Allah, so accept my excuse,
have mercy upon the severity of my affliction,
and release me from the tightness of my fetters.
My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body,
the thinness of my skin,
and the frailty of my bones.
O You Who gave rise to my creation, to the remembrance of me,

verses.arabic: وَ تَرْبِیَتِیْ وَ بِرِّیْ وَ تَغْذِیَتِیْ،
verses.translation: to the nurture of me, to goodness toward me, and to nourishment on me!
(please) Bestow upon me for the sake of Your having given rise [to me] with generosity
and Your previous goodness to me!

verses.arabic: یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ رَبِّیْ،
verses.translation: O my God, Master and Lord!

verses.arabic: اَ تُرَاكَ مُعَذِّبِیْ بِنَارِكَ بَعْدَ تَوْحِیْدِكَ
verses.translation: Will You torment me with Your fire after I have professed Your Unity,

verses.arabic: وَ بَعْدَ مَا انْطَوٰی عَلَیْہِ قَلْبِیْ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِكَ
verses.translation: and after the knowledge of You my heart has embraced,

verses.arabic: وَ لَھِجَ بِہٖ لِسَانِیْ مِنْ ذِكْرِكَ
verses.translation: the remembrance of You my tongue has constantly mentioned,
the love of You to which my mind has clung,

verses.arabic: وَ بَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِیْ وَ دُعَاۤئِـیْ
verses.translation: and the sincerity of my confession and my supplication,
humble before Your lordship?
Far be it from You!

verses.arabic: اَنْتَ اَكْرَمُ مِنْ اَنْ تُضَیِّعَ مَنْ رَبَّیْتَہٗ،
verses.translation: You are too generous to squander him whom You have nurtured,
banish him whom You have brought nigh,
drive away him whom You have given an abode,

verses.arabic: اَوْ تُسَلِّمَ اِلَی الْبَلۤاۤءِ مَنْ كَفَیْتَہٗ وَ رَحِمْتَہٗ،
verses.translation: or submit to tribulation him whom You have saved and shown mercy.

verses.arabic: وَ لَیْتَ شِعْرِیْ یَا سَیِّدِیْ وَ اِلٰھِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ.
verses.translation: Would that I knew, my Master, God and Protector,
will You give the Fire dominion over faces
fallen down prostrate before Your Tremendousness,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰی اَلْسُنٍ نَطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِیْدِكَ صَادِقَۃً
verses.translation: over tongues voicing sincerely the profession of Your Unity
and giving thanks to You in praise,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰی قُلُوْبٍ اِعْتَرَفَتْ بِاِلٰھِیَّتِكَ مُحَقِّقَۃً
verses.translation: over hearts acknowledging Your Divinity through verification,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰی ضَمَاۤئِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ
verses.translation: over minds encompassing knowledge of You
until they have become humble,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰی جَوَارِحَ سَعَتْ اِلٰی اَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَاۤئِعَۃً
verses.translation: over organs speeding to the places of Your worship in obedience
and beckoning for Your forgiveness in submission?
No such opinion is held of You
nor has such been reported - thanks to. Your bounty concerning You.
O All-generous! My Lord,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِیْ عَنْ قَلِیْلٍ مِّنْ بَلَاۤءِ الدُّنْیَا وَ عُقُوْبَاتِھَا،
verses.translation: and You know my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments,

verses.arabic: وَ مَا یَجْرِیْ فِیْھَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِہِ عَلٰی اَھْلِھَا،
verses.translation: and before those ordeals which befall its inhabitants,

verses.arabic: عَلٰی اَنَّ ذٰلِكَ بَلَاۤءٌ وَّ مَكْرُوْہٌ
verses.translation: even though it is a tribulation and ordeal
whose stay is short,
subsistence is little,
and period is fleeting.
How can I then endure the tribulations of the next world
and the great ordeals that occur within it?
It is a tribulation whose period is long,
station endures,
and sufferers are given no respite,

verses.arabic: لِاَنَّہٗ لَا یَكُوْنُ اِلَّا عَنْ غَضَبِكَ
verses.translation: since it only occurs as a result of Your wrath,
vengeance, and anger,

verses.arabic: وَ ھٰذَا مَا لَا تَقُوْمُ لَہُ السَّمٰوَاتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ.
verses.translation: which cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth.
O Master, so what about me?
For I am Your weak, lowly,
base, wretched, and miserable slave.

verses.arabic: یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ رَبِّیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ.
verses.translation: My God! My Lord! My Master! My Protector!
For which things would I complain to You?

verses.arabic: وَ لِمَا مِنْھَا اَضِجُّ وَ اَبْكِیْ
verses.translation: For which of them would I lament and weep?
For the pain and severity of chastisement?
Or for the length and period of tribulation?
So, if You take me to the punishments with Your enemies,

verses.arabic: وَ جَمَعْتَ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَ اَھْلِ بَلَاۤئِكَ،
verses.translation: gather me with the people of Your tribulation,

verses.arabic: وَ فَرَّقْتَ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَ اَحِبَّاۤئِكَ وَ اَوْلِیَاۤئِكَ،
verses.translation: and separate me from Your friends and saints,

verses.arabic: فَھَبْنِیْ یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ وَ رَبِّیْ.
verses.translation: then suppose—My God, Master, Protector, and Lord—
that I am able to endure Your chastisement,
how can I endure separation from You?

verses.arabic: وَ ھَبْنِیْ صَبَرْتُ عَلٰی حَرِّ نَارِكَ،
verses.translation: Suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Your fire,

verses.arabic: فَكَیْفَ اَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ اِلٰی كَرَامَتِكَ
verses.translation: how can I endure not gazing upon Your generosity?

verses.arabic: اَمْ كَیْفَ اَسْكُنُ فِیْ النَّارِ وَ رَجَاۤئـِیْ عَفْوُكَ
verses.translation: How can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?

verses.arabic: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ یَا سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ اُقْسِمُ صَادِقًا
verses.translation: So by Your might, my Master and protector, I swear sincerely,
if You leave me with speech,

verses.arabic: لَاَضِجَّنَّ اِلَیْكَ بَیْنَ اَھْلِھَا ضَجِیْجَ الْاٰمِلِیْنَ،
verses.translation: I will lament to You from the midst of the Fire's inhabitants with lamentation of the hopeful,
I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help,
I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft,

verses.arabic: وَ لَاُنَادِیَنَّكَ اَیْنَ كُنْتَ یَا وَلِیَّ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
verses.translation: and I will call to You: Where are You, O Sponsor of the believers,
O Goal of the hopes of Your knowers,
O Aide of those who seek assistance,
O Friend of the hearts of the sincere,
O God of all the world's inhabitants!

verses.arabic: اَفَتُرَاكَ سُبْحَانَكَ یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ بِحَمْدِكَ،
verses.translation: Will You— Glory be to You, My God, and Yours is the praised —
hear therein the voice of a slave surrendered to You,
imprisoned there because of his violations,
tasting the favor of its torment because of his disobedience,

verses.arabic: وَ حُبِسَ بَیْنَ اَطْبَاقِھَا بِجُرْمِہٖ وَ جَرِیْرَتِہٖ
verses.translation: and confined within its layers because of his sin and crime,

verses.arabic: وَ ھُوَ یَضِجُّ اِلَیْكَ ضَجِیْجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ  لِرَحْمَتِكَ،
verses.translation: while he laments to You with the lament of one hopeful for Your mercy,
calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your Unity,
and entreats You by Your lordship!

verses.arabic: یَا مَوْلَایَ، فَكَیْفَ یَبْقٰی فِی الْعَذَابِ
verses.translation: My Protector, so how should he remain in the chastisement

verses.arabic: وَ ھُوَ یَرْجُوْ مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
verses.translation: while he has hope for Your previous clemency?
How should the Fire cause him pain

verses.arabic: وَ ھُوَ یَاْمُلُ فَضْلَكَ وَ رَحْمَتَكَ.
verses.translation: while he expects Your bounty and mercy?
How should its flames burn him

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَہٗ وَ تَرٰی مَكَانَہٗ.
verses.translation: while You hear his voice and see his place?
How should its groaning encompass him
while You know his weakness?
How should he be convulsed among its levels
while You know his sincerity?
How should its keepers torture him
while he calls out to You, O Lord?

verses.arabic: اَمْ كَیْفَ یَرْجُوْ فَضْلَكَ فِیْ عِتْقِہٖ مِنْھَا
verses.translation: How should he have hope for Your bounty in freeing him from it
while You abandon him therein?
Far be it from You[ That is not what is expected from You
nor what is well-known of Your bounty,

verses.arabic: وَ لَا مُشْبِہٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِہِ الْمُوَحِّدِیْنَ
verses.translation: nor is it similar to the goodness and kindness
You have shown to those who profess Your Unity.
So I declare with certainty

verses.arabic: لَوْلَا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِہٖ مِنْ تَعْذِیْبِ جَاحِدِیْكَ،
verses.translation: that were it not for what You have decreed concerning the chastisement of Your deniers

verses.arabic: وَ قَضَیْتَ بِہٖ مِنْ اِخْلَادِ مُعَانِدِیْكَ،
verses.translation: and what You have foreordained concerning the everlasting home of those who stubbornly resist,

verses.arabic: لَجَعَلْتَ النَّارَ كُلَّھَا بَرْدًا وَّ سَلَامًا،
verses.translation: You would make the Fire, entirely, coolness and safety,

verses.arabic: وَ مَا كَانَ لِاَحَدٍ فِیْھَا مَقَرًّا وَّ لَا مُقَامًا،
verses.translation: and no one would have a place of rest or abode within it.
But You—holy are Your Names
have sworn that You will fill it with the unbelievers,
both jinn and men together,
and place those who stubbornly resist therein forever.

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاۤؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدِءًا،
verses.translation: Moreover, You— majestic is Your eulogy— said at the beginning
and were gracious through kindness as a favor:

verses.arabic: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا یَسْتَوُوْنَ.
verses.translation: “What? Is he who has been believer like him who has been ungodly? They are not equal.”
My God and Master!
So I ask You by the power You have apportioned,

verses.arabic: وَ بِالْقَضِیَّۃِ الَّتِیْ حَتَمْتَھَا وَ حَكَمْتَھَا،
verses.translation: the decision You have determined and imposed
and through which You have overcome him toward whom it has been put into effect,

verses.arabic: اَنْ تَھَبَ لِیْ فِیْ ھٰذِہِ اللَّیْلَۃِ
verses.translation: that You forgive me in this night
and at this hour
every offence I have committed,
every sin I have performed,
every ugly thing I have concealed,
and every folly I have enacted
whether I have hidden, announced,
concealed, or manifested it,

verses.arabic: وَ كُلَّ سَیِّئَۃٍ اَمَرْتَ بِاِثْبَاتِھَا الْكِرَامَ الْكَاتِبِیْنَ،
verses.translation: every evil, act which You have commanded the Noble Writers to record,

verses.arabic: الَّذِیْنَ وَكَّلْتَھُمْ بِحِفْظِ مَا یَكُوْنُ مِنِّیْ،
verses.translation: those whom You have appointed to watch over what appears from me,

verses.arabic: وَ جَعَلْتَھُمْ شُھُوْدًا عَلَیَّ مَعَ جَوَارِحِیْ،
verses.translation: whom You have made, along with my organs, witness against me,

verses.arabic: وَ كُنْتَ اَنْتَ الرَّقِیْبَ عَلَیَّ مِنْ وَّرَاۤئِھِمْ
verses.translation: and You were the Watcher over me from behind them
and the Witness of what is hidden from them,
but through Your mercy You concealed it,
and through Your bounty You veiled it,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّیْ مِنْ كُلِّ خَیْرٍ اَنْزَلْتَہٗ،
verses.translation: bestow upon me an abundant share of every good You send down,
kindness You confer,
goodness You unfold,
provision You spread out,
sin You forgive,
or error You cover.

verses.arabic: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ،
verses.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

verses.arabic: یَا اِلٰھِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلَایَ وَمَالِكَ رِقِّی،ْ
verses.translation: My God! My Master! My Protector! Owner of my bondage!
O  He in Whose hand is my forelock!
O He Who knows my affliction and my misery!
O He Who is aware of my poverty and indigence!

verses.arabic: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ،
verses.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
I beseech You in the name of Your Truth, Holiness,
and the greatest of Your Attributes and Names,

verses.arabic: اَنْ تَجْعَلَ اَوْقَاتِیْ مِنَ اللَّیْلِ وَ النَّھَارِ،
verses.translation: to make my times in the night and the day
inhabited by Your remembrance,
and joined to Your service,
and to make my works acceptable to You,

verses.arabic: حَتّٰی تَكُوْنَ اَعْمَالِیْ وَ اَوْرَادِیْ كُلّھَا وِرْدًا وَّاحِدًا،
verses.translation: so that my works and litanies may all be a single litany,
and my occupation with Your service everlasting.

verses.arabic: یَا سَیِّدِیْ، یَا مَنْ عَلَیْہِ مُعَوَّلِیْ،
verses.translation: My Master! O He upon Whom I depend!
O He to Whom I complain about my states!

verses.arabic: یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ یَا رَبِّ،
verses.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
Strengthen my organs in Your service,
fortify my ribs in determination,

verses.arabic: وَ ھَبْ لِیَ الْجِدَّ فِیْ خَشْیَتِكَ،
verses.translation: bestow upon me earnestness in my fear of You
and continuity in my being joined to Your service

verses.arabic: حَتّٰی اَسْرَحَ اِلَیْكَ فِیْ مَیَادِیْنِ السَّابِقِیْنَ،
verses.translation: so that I may move easily toward You in the fields of the foremost,
hurry to You among the prominent,
desire fervently Your proximity among the fervently desirous,
move nearer to You with the nearness of the sincere,
fear You with the fear of those who have certitude,

verses.arabic: وَ اجْتَمِعَ فِیْ جَوَارِكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ.
verses.translation: and gather with the believers in Your vicinity.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ وَ مَنْ اَرَادَ نِیْ بِسُوْۤءٍ فَاَرِدْہُ،
verses.translation: O Allah, whoever desires evil for me, desire [it] for him!
Whoever deceives me, deceive him!

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِیْ مِنْ اَحْسَنِ عَبِیْدِكَ نَصِیْبًا عِنْدَكَ،
verses.translation: Make me one of Your most excellent slaves in portion in Your decree,
the nearest of them in station to You,
and the most elected in proximity to You,

verses.arabic: فَاِنَّہٗ لَا یُنَالُ ذٰلِكَ اِلَّا بِفَضْلِكَ،
verses.translation: for that cannot be attained except by Your bounty.
Grant generously to me through Your munificence,
incline toward me with Your splendor,
protect me with Your mercy,
make my tongue remember You without ceasing
and my heart enthralled by Your love,
be gracious to me by answering me favorably,
nullify my slips,
and forgive my lapses!
For You have decreed Your worship for Your servants,
commanded them to supplicate You,
and assured them that they would be answered.
So, toward You, my Lord, I have turned my face,

verses.arabic: وَ اِلَیْكَ یَا رَبِّ مَدَدْتُ یَدِیْ،
verses.translation: and toward You, my Lord, I have extended my hand.
So, in the name of Your might, respond to my supplication,
make me attain my desires,

verses.arabic: وَ لَا تَقْطَعْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ رَجَاۤئـِیْ،
verses.translation: do not severe my hoping for Your favours

verses.arabic: وَاكْفِنِیْ شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ مِنْ اَعْدَاۤئـِیْ،
verses.translation: and spare me the evil of my enemies from among jinn and men!
O He, whose pleasure is quickly achieved!

verses.arabic: اِغْفِرْ لِمَنْ لَا یَمْلِكُ اِلَّا الدُّعَاۤءَ،
verses.translation: Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication
For You do what you will.
O He whose Name is a remedy,
Whose remembrance is a cure,
And whose obedience is wealth!
Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope
And whose weapon is tears!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Light of those who are lonely in the darkness!
O Knower who was never taught!

verses.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
verses.translation: Bless Muhammad and Muhammad's household!
And do with me what is worthy of You!
May Allah bless His messenger
and the holy Imams of his household
And give them abundant peace!
